statement.en: The first line has n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1 000 000), the second line n integers. Print them in reverse order, separated by spaces.

generators.code:
import random

# Arguments on stdin: n and a seed.
n, seed = map(int, input().split())
random.seed(seed)
print(n)
print(" ".join(str(random.randint(-10**9, 10**9)) for _ in range(n)))

statement.en: Read one line. Print YES if its brackets (), [] and {} are balanced and properly nested, otherwise NO. Other characters are ignored.
